translations.web: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
translations.bsb: Arrogance leads only to strife, but wisdom is with the well-advised.
translations.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
translations.asv: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.
